verdicts.reason: A keeps the pills together as one row and gives the CTA a strong place on the right. But SOLSTICE sits under the headline, which flips the reading order. The tagline is squeezed into a tiny two-line block beside the pills and can't be read, the CTA is jammed against the right edge, and the left side is mostly empty decorative circles. B breaks apart in several ways. SOLSTICE is pushed to the left edge and printed on top of the yellow circle. The three flavour pills are scattered at different heights, with Honey Rosemary stacked under the CTA and nowhere near the other two. The CTA crowds the peach circle. The result is a jumbled right half with no grid.
